ui.unveilDestiny: Unveil Your Destiny, Card by Card...
ui.gateAnonBody: One glimpse is all the spirits grant a wandering soul. To part the veil again, you must first be known to us.
ui.gateFreeBody: Tonight's fates are spent. Deeper visions are not given freely — offer tribute, and the cards will speak again.
ui.profileTitle: What the Veil Knows About You
ui.forgotPasswordIntro: Give us the name you pledged, and we will send a way back in.
ui.resetLinkSent: If that name is known to us, a way back is on its way. Check your inbox.
ui.resetPasswordSuccess: Your new phrase is sealed. Step back through the gate.
ui.resetPasswordInvalid: This way back has withered. Ask for another.
ui.resetEmailSubject: A way back into The Veil
ui.resetEmailIntro: Someone asked to forge a new phrase for your account.
ui.resetEmailExpiry: The link fades in one hour.
ui.resetEmailIgnore: If this was not you, ignore this message — nothing has changed.
ui.verifyEmailSubject: Confirm your tether to the living
ui.verifyEmailIntro: Confirm this address so the Veil can reach you.
ui.verifyEmailExpiry: The link fades in a day.
ui.verifyEmailIgnore: If this was not you, ignore this message — nothing has changed.
ui.verifyEmailSuccess: Your tether holds. The Veil can reach you now.
ui.verifyEmailInvalid: This link has withered. Ask for another from the offering screen.
ui.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email before making an offering — a receipt that cannot reach you is worth nothing.
ui.verificationSent: The link is on its way. Check your inbox, then try again.

ui.profileForgeSeal: Forge the Seal, Set a New One

ui.avatarBadType: That form won't hold — use PNG, JPG, or WebP.

ui.oneReadingAtATime: One reading at a time, or unlimited every day.
